subject: general
question: Who was the founder of a non-violent movement named as "Khudai Khidmatgars"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khudai Khidmatgars was a non-violent movement in the North-West Frontier Province of British India, which is now in Pakistan.**
 
• The movement was started by** Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan,** who was also known as the **Frontier Gandhi.**
 
• The Khudai Khidmatgars were also known as the **"Red Shirts**" because of the **color** of their uniforms.
 
• **The movement was based on the principles of non-violence, social justice, and democracy.**
 
• The Khudai Khidmatgars played an important role in the** Indian independence movement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **C. Rajagopalachari was a prominent Indian politician and independence activist.**

 
 
• He was the **last Governor-General **of India.
 
 
 
• **Mohammad Ali Jinnah was the founder of Pakistan and the leader of the All India Muslim League.**
 
 
• He played a major role** **in the partition of India.
 
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi was the leader of the Indian independence movement and is known for his principles of non-violence.**
 
 
• He was a close associate of Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan and supported the** Khudai Khidmatgars.**
